what_each_new_part_touches: Inside the yellow box (sub-steps 1-4, built twice) a light-grey 5-hole beam gets two blue pins, a 15-hole beam is laid on top, and two L-beams with a blue pin each are hung under it.
The two finished side builds (arrows) are then lowered on the left and right of the base.
where_everything_is_after: two side builds, each a 15-hole beam on a grey 5-hole beam with two L-beams hanging down, sit on the left and right of the base

why.problem_solved: Builds the two long side members that will carry the track wheels.
why.why_these_parts: Each side needs a very long 15-hole beam; the grey 5-hole beam and L-beams give it depth and hold the wheel axles.
why.sets_up_for_later: Steps 6-12 add cross beams and the turntable base between these sides.

review_note: The sub-steps in the yellow box are listed as one step here.
